games.title: Left 4 Dead 2
games.notes: 32-bit DirectX 9. Runs natively (no Steam client) with WineD3D.
games.testedWith: MacNative 0.1.0, Wine Staging 11.18, M2 Pro, macOS 27

games.title: Fable Anniversary
games.notes: Works with the CrossOver Wine 24.0.7 engine (downloaded automatically). On Wine 11 it hangs before the window opens: the executable is mixed-mode .NET, which CrossOver's Wine handles.
games.testedWith: MacNative 0.1.0, CrossOver Wine 24.0.7, M2 Pro, macOS 27

games.title: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition
games.notes: The GOG installer crashes under Wine 11; MacNative retries automatically with the compatibility engine, which installs it. Gameplay not reported yet.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - Game of the Year Edition Deluxe
games.notes: Runs with DXVK. The installer can't run silently because it has a license page: MacNative retries with the compatibility engine and shows the installer window, so accept the license and click through. Tested installed on and running from an external exFAT drive.
games.testedWith: MacNative 0.1.3, Wine Staging 11.21, Apple M6 Mac mini, macOS 27.2

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Game of the Year Edition
games.notes: Runs with DXVK. Result carried over from the Game of the Year Edition Deluxe; this edition hasn't been installed separately. If the installer has a license page, MacNative retries with the compatibility engine and shows the installer window, so accept the license and click through.
games.testedWith: Deluxe edition: MacNative 0.1.3, Wine Staging 11.21, Apple M6 Mac mini, macOS 27.2
